companies.name: Miso Robotics
companies.summary: Miso builds Flippy, an AI-powered robotic fry station for commercial kitchens, alongside software that helps restaurant operators manage daily work.
companies.whyItMatters: Its products automate repetitive kitchen tasks and give restaurant teams more visibility into operations.
companies.statusEvidence: Issuer page currently displays Invest Now and common-stock terms. July 20, 2026 SEC supplement confirms Republic as an additional platform for this Reg A offering. The Republic page itself returned 403 and was not directly verified.
companies.minimumNote: 192 shares, plus a 3.5% transaction fee; not an all-in total.
companies.deadlineNote: SEC supplement: terminates when maximum is sold, three years from initial qualification, or earlier at issuer discretion. The plan states an intention to continue for one year following qualification; no exact closing date should be inferred.
companies.useOfProceeds: Intended net-proceeds allocation in the January 2026 offering circular: 45% payroll, 35% marketing, 10% product development, and 10% general administration. Management may change allocations.

companies.name: Atombeam
companies.summary: Atombeam develops Neurpac, software designed to compact data from connected devices before transmission and storage.
companies.whyItMatters: The company aims to help organizations move more machine data across existing networks without changing hardware.
companies.statusEvidence: Issuer investment page says LIVE OFFERING and displays a September 17, 2026 closing date. StartEngine offers a GET EQUITY action. Availability was observed on September 13, 2026, not guaranteed thereafter.
companies.minimumNote: 43 shares, plus a 3.5% processing fee per offering circular.
companies.deadlineNote: Date displayed on issuer investment page; subject to issuer changes.
companies.useOfProceeds: Software development for PCM, sales and marketing, general administration, capital expenditures, capitalized R&D, and working-capital reserves. Allocations depend on funds raised and may change at management discretion.

companies.name: Greenfield Robotics
companies.summary: Greenfield builds BOTONY, autonomous agricultural robots that use computer vision and mechanical weed control between crop rows.
companies.whyItMatters: The company is developing a field-operations platform intended to reduce farms’ reliance on herbicides.
companies.statusEvidence: Issuer page says REG A+ OPEN and INVEST NOW. The linked SEC document is explicitly a September 3, 2026 preliminary circular, so final qualification and portal availability have not been independently verified.
companies.minimumNote: 242 shares plus a 3.5% transaction fee; preliminary circular states an all-in total of $518.47. Minimum is advertised by the issuer; final terms need confirmation.
companies.deadlineNote: Issuer page displayed deadline, not independently verified against a final qualified circular.
companies.useOfProceeds: Preliminary circular lists manufacturing and production, field operations and deployment, R&D, sales and marketing, general administration, debt retirement, and working capital. A portion of the offering is sales by existing stockholders; those proceeds do not go to the issuer.

companies.name: Graze Robotics
companies.summary: Graze developed autonomous electric commercial lawn mowers designed to reduce fuel use and the labor required for mowing.
companies.whyItMatters: Its offering illustrates how robotics can automate recurring grounds-maintenance work.

companies.deadlineNote: Historical page deadline is July 1, 2021 at 6:59 AM UTC. This is not a current investment opportunity.
companies.useOfProceedsNote: Not verified from the historical offering circular; no current use-of-proceeds claim should be shown.

editorialNotes: Miso, Atombeam, and Greenfield are currently advertised by their issuers. Use issuer-reported status language, not a guarantee of investment availability.
For a strict verified-active-only filter, exclude Greenfield pending final circular/qualification confirmation, and exclude historical Graze.
All linked assets are downloaded original materials, not AI-created substitutes. Reuse rights were not independently established.
Excluded BOXABL: current official site says it trades on Nasdaq as BXBL, so it is not presented as an active crowdfunding equity raise.
Excluded Future Acres: current domain serves unrelated content.
Republic returned HTTP 403. It was not bypassed. Miso Republic association is confirmed by SEC supplement.
